features.detail: Ambiguous timeout and generic transport failures are not retried; explicit retryable ToolError is bounded.
Tool calls consume a step and are bounded by the remaining elapsed-time budget.

features.evidence: P02 itself owns no runtime; the caller reports usage. P05 phase 037 does it on the live path: artifacts/evidence/status-reconcile/p05-adapter-red.txt; p05-adapter-green.txt; p05-adapter-check-fast.txt; deployed on Fly with one live run under the limit: p05 artifacts/evidence/status-reconcile/live-demo-runs-after-adapter.json

features.detail: Documented subset rejects unknown keywords, bool-as-number, and non-finite inputs/outputs.

features.evidence: artifacts/evals/live/p02-dev-v1/report.json; artifacts/evals/live/p02-dev-v1/trials.jsonl; artifacts/evidence/live-campaign-runner/. Development split only (24 cases, one trial each, 24 Groq calls): 13/24 passed (Wilson 95% 0.351 to 0.721); all 11 failures are the tool-selection check; decision, escalation and abstention matched in 24/24. 8,441 input and 2,189 output tokens, estimated USD 0.00129 on free-plan keys (billed amount UNKNOWN); latency p50 590 ms, p95 1,147 ms. Holdout and confirmation not run; corpus context and grader are assistant-authored; human review PENDING; independent review WAIVED_BY_OWNER.

features.detail: Local search returns only positive-overlap documents with stable untrusted source IDs; retrieved text can be screened by the shared heuristic guard. Citation-ID membership is checked only; external RAG, tenant isolation, entailment, and holdout or independent model-refusal evidence remain INCOMPLETE. On the 24-case development split a real model refused 18/18 cases that required it, refused 0/6 that should be answered, resisted 3/3 injection cases and stated the article value in 3/3 knowledge cases; synthetic, one trial per case, human review PENDING.
KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit propagate without wrapping or retrying the tool handler; timeout outcomes remain indeterminate and are not retried automatically.
